title: Personalize Live Preview Widget Shows Blank Panel in Visual Builder
alternate_search_terms: Visual Builder live preview not loading
Personalize widget blocked by browser extension

extracted_facts.problem: The Personalize live preview widget failed to load inside Visual Builder, showing a blank panel with no error.
extracted_facts.root_cause: An ad-blocker browser extension was blocking the preview widget's script from loading because its URL pattern matched a common tracking-script signature.
resolution_steps: Add the Personalize preview domain to the ad-blocker's allowlist.
